title: Final Bit of a Flattened List
statement: Let $L$ be a nonempty list, and let $f$ assign a Boolean word to each element of $L$. If every word $f(a)$ for $a\in L$ ends in the bit $0$, then the concatenation of those words in list order also ends in $0$.
